# logos nogo for Go packages: printf, SA5001, and checklocks findings via
# logos lint, original file:line, //logos:allow, warn/deny/forbid caps,
# --json-diagnostics, and plain-go separation. Helper lives at
# $GOROOT/lib/logos-nogo; behavior only, no source wiring or registry count.
# printf uses a local formatf wrapper: the native check covers std calls
# only, so logos lint stays helper-only, while vet infers the wrapper and
# nogo flags the call.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

# printf is deny by default at its original Go path, never an eject temp.
cd printf
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'eject'
! exists printf
! exists printf$GOEXE
# logos build and go build run no nogo.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/printf$GOEXE .
! stderr .
go build -o $WORK/bin/printf-go$GOEXE .
! stderr .
# go vet sees the same bug through the std analyzer's wrapper inference,
# never as nogo.
! go vet ./...
stderr 'formatf'
! stderr 'nogo::'
cd ..

# SA5001 defers Close before checking the error: a real nil-Close bug.
cd sa
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:7:.*\[nogo::sa5001\]'
! stderr 'eject'
# The std vet suite has no SA5001.
go vet ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# checklocks flags the unlocked guarded-field write at its Go line.
cd locks
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:12:.*\[nogo::checklocks\]'
! stderr 'eject'
# std vet has no checklocks.
go vet ./...
! stderr .
logos build -o $WORK/bin/locks$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cd ..

# //logos:allow silences printf and checklocks at deny.
cd allowed
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

cd locksallowed
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# nogo = "warn" prints with the warning prefix and exits 0.
cd warned
logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:.*warning: \[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'eject'
cd ..

# nogo = "forbid" caps to deny in Go: fails without a warning prefix,
# and allow still silences with no allow_forbidden_rule.
cd forbid
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
! stderr 'allow_forbidden_rule'
cd ..

cd forbidallowed
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
! stderr 'allow_forbidden_rule'
cd ..

# --json-diagnostics prints one schema-1.0 object per line at the original
# file with deny severity; no # header and no warning prefix in JSON.
cd printf
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*\}$'
stderr '"schema_version":"1\.0"'
stderr '"rule_id":"nogo::printf"'
stderr '"severity":"deny"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*main\.go"'
stderr '"span":\{"start_line":6,'
stderr '"provenance":'
stderr '"autofix_candidates":\[\]'
! stderr '^#'
! stderr 'warning:'
cd ..

# Warn severity in JSON exits 0.
cd warned
logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*\}$'
stderr '"rule_id":"nogo::printf"'
stderr '"severity":"warn"'
! stderr '^#'
cd ..

# Forbid caps to deny in JSON for Go, never forbid.
cd forbid
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr '"rule_id":"nogo::printf"'
stderr '"severity":"deny"'
! stderr '"severity":"forbid"'
cd ..

# A dependency module gets no nogo; as its own main module it fails.
cd app
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
logos build ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

cd dep
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'dep\.go:7:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
cd ..

# An allow directive covers exactly one statement: a second violation in
# the same function still fails.
cd scoped
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:8:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'main\.go:7:'
stderr -count=1 '\[nogo::printf\]'
cd ..

# An allow above a multi-line statement covers a finding inside it, and
# the next statement still fails.
cd wrapline
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:10:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'main\.go:8:'
stderr -count=1 '\[nogo::printf\]'
cd ..

# A blank line ends the directive's reach: the detached allow silences
# nothing.
cd detached
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:8:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
stderr -count=1 '\[nogo::printf\]'
cd ..

# An allow naming another rule does not silence the finding, and stays
# silent itself.
cd mismatch
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:7:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
stderr -count=1 '\[nogo::printf\]'
cd ..

# Plain go has no lint command and no --json-diagnostics flag.
cd printf
! go lint ./...
stderr 'unknown command'
! go build --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr 'flag provided but not defined: -json-diagnostics'
cd ..

-- printf/go.mod --
module example.com/printf

go 1.27

-- printf/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	println(formatf("%d", "hello"))
}

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

-- sa/go.mod --
module example.com/sa

go 1.27

-- sa/main.go --
package main

import "os"

func open(p string) (*os.File, error) {
	f, err := os.Open(p)
	defer f.Close()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return f, nil
}

func main() {
	f, err := open("x")
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	defer f.Close()
}

-- locks/go.mod --
module example.com/locks

go 1.27

-- locks/main.go --
package main

import "sync"

type Guarded struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	// +checklocks:mu
	val int
}

func (g *Guarded) Set(v int) {
	g.val = v
}

func (g *Guarded) SetLocked(v int) {
	g.mu.Lock()
	defer g.mu.Unlock()
	g.val = v
}

func main() {
	g := &Guarded{}
	g.Set(1)
}

-- allowed/go.mod --
module example.com/allowed

go 1.27

-- allowed/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	//logos:allow(nogo::printf)
	println(formatf("%d", "hello"))
}

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

-- locksallowed/go.mod --
module example.com/locksallowed

go 1.27

-- locksallowed/main.go --
package main

import "sync"

type Guarded struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	// +checklocks:mu
	val int
}

func (g *Guarded) Set(v int) {
	//logos:allow(nogo::checklocks)
	g.val = v
}

func (g *Guarded) SetLocked(v int) {
	g.mu.Lock()
	defer g.mu.Unlock()
	g.val = v
}

func main() {
	g := &Guarded{}
	g.Set(1)
}

-- warned/go.mod --
module example.com/warned

go 1.27

-- warned/logos.toml --
[lints]
nogo = "warn"

-- warned/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	println(formatf("%d", "hello"))
}

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

-- app/go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dep => ../dep

-- app/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/dep"

func main() {
	println(dep.Name())
}

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.27

-- dep/dep.go --
// Package dep provides a name.
package dep

import "fmt"

func Name() string {
	return formatf("%d", "hello")
}

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}
-- scoped/go.mod --
module example.com/scoped

go 1.27

-- scoped/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	//logos:allow(nogo::printf)
	println(formatf("%d", "hello"))
	println(formatf("%d", "hello"))
}

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

-- wrapline/go.mod --
module example.com/wrapline

go 1.27

-- wrapline/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	//logos:allow(nogo::printf)
	println(
		formatf("%d", "hello"),
	)
	println(formatf("%d", "hello"))
}

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

-- detached/go.mod --
module example.com/detached

go 1.27

-- detached/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	//logos:allow(nogo::printf)

	println(formatf("%d", "hello"))
}

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

-- mismatch/go.mod --
module example.com/mismatch

go 1.27

-- mismatch/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	//logos:allow(nogo::sa5001)
	println(formatf("%d", "hello"))
}

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}
